fullPassage: Scholars have demonstrated that the gestures hearing people produce while they are speaking are systematically made at the same time with speech such that language and gesture must be considered "co-expressive". This tightly integrated pairing of language and gesture enables speakers to conceptualize and formulate their thoughts in terms of both the "categorical" requirements of language, and the "imagistic" possibilities of gesture. ( ① ) For example, in describing an event, one must decide if the event has been completed or is ongoing if the language being spoken at that moment has a verbal affix for each meaning and one or the other must be chosen. ( ② ) This kind of choice is characteristic of language as a semiotic system. ( ③ ) Instead, it offers a kind of glue, which helps unite linguistic elements in a larger semiotic expression, which, as a whole, shares important characteristics with the represented objects. ( ④ ) In this view, speech and gesture are not redundant nor is one a "translation" of the other. ( ⑤ ) Rather, the minimal processing unit for the expression of thought is a combination of the two: it is "imagistic-categorial" in nature.

✅ ① semiotic: 기호와 상징을 통한 의미 소통 체계 ←정답
❌ ② acoustic: 음향의 — 소리 관련
❌ ③ semantic: 의미론적인 — 의미 자체에 초점
❌ ④ synthetic: 합성의 — 인공적 결합
det.tip: semiotic = relating to signs and symbols as a system of communication

questions.passage: This tightly __________ (integrate) pairing of language and gesture enables speakers to conceptualize and formulate their thoughts in terms of both the "categorical" requirements of language, and the "imagistic" possibilities of gesture.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: integrate → integrated: 과거분사 형용사로 pairing을 수식
det.analysis: integrate(통합하다)의 과거분사 integrated가 명사 pairing 앞에서 형용사로 사용. tightly integrated pairing = 긴밀히 통합된 짝지음

questions.passage: Instead, it offers a kind of glue, which helps unite linguistic elements in a larger semiotic expression, which, as a whole, shares important characteristics with the __________ (represent) objects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: represent → represented: 과거분사 형용사로 objects를 수식
det.analysis: represent(나타내다)의 과거분사 represented가 명사 objects 앞에서 형용사로 사용. the represented objects = 표상된 대상들

questions.passage: Scholars have demonstrated that the gestures hearing people produce while they are speaking are systematically made at the same time with speech such that language and gesture must be considered "__________". This tightly integrated pairing of language and gesture enables speakers to conceptualize and formulate their thoughts in terms of both the "categorical" requirements of language, and the "imagistic" possibilities of gesture. ( ① ) For example, in describing an event, one must decide if the event has been completed or is ongoing if the language being spoken at that moment has a verbal affix for each meaning and one or the other must be chosen. ( ② ) This kind of choice is characteristic of language as a semiotic system. ( ③ ) Instead, it offers a kind of glue, which helps unite linguistic elements in a larger semiotic expression, which, as a whole, shares important characteristics with the represented objects. ( ④ ) In this view, speech and gesture are not redundant nor is one a "translation" of the other. ( ⑤ ) Rather, the minimal processing unit for the expression of thought is a combination of the two: it is "imagistic-categorial" in nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: co-expressive(공동 표현적인) — 언어와 제스처가 함께 표현하는 관계
det.analysis:
❌ ① contradictory: 모순적인 — 문맥 반대
✅ ② co-expressive: 언어와 제스처가 공동 표현적으로 여겨져야 한다 ←정답
❌ ③ independent: 독립적인 — 통합 관계와 모순
❌ ④ decorative: 장식적인 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: language and gesture must be considered 'co-expressive'

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: a combination of the two(둘의 결합) — 사고 표현의 최소 처리 단위는 둘의 결합
det.analysis:
✅ ① a combination of the two: 발화와 제스처의 결합 ←정답
❌ ② a separation of the two: 둘의 분리 — 문맥 반대
❌ ③ a contradiction between them: 모순 — 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ an elimination of gesture: 제스처 제거 — 문맥과 반대
det.tip: the minimal processing unit for the expression of thought is a combination of the two
